product_overview: Bovix is a mobile-first dairy farm management app that helps farmers track cattle, milk production, and feed stock in one place. It is designed to work offline and sync data when connectivity returns.
core_goals: Log and manage cattle records for the herd
Record daily milk production and compare farm logs against buyer receipts
Track feed and medicine stock levels and usage
View a quick operational snapshot of the farm from the dashboard
Authenticate securely and manage the user session

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allows users to sign in with email and password and access the authenticated parts of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the login form with invalid credentials -> See an authentication error message
Open settings -> Sign out -> Return to the login screen

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Shows a high-level snapshot of farm performance, including cattle count, milk production, and stock alerts.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View total cattle count -> View today's milk production -> View low stock alerts -> Open a relevant farm section from a quick action

features.name: Cattle Management
features.description: Lets users view the herd, search and filter cattle, add new animals, open a cattle profile, and remove cattle records.
user_flows: Navigate to /cattle -> View the cattle list -> Search for a cattle by tag or name -> Open a cattle profile -> Review detailed cattle information
Navigate to /cattle -> Open the add cattle flow -> Enter cattle details -> Submit the form -> See the new cattle appear in the herd list
Navigate to /cattle -> Open the add cattle flow -> Leave required cattle details incomplete -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback
Navigate to /cattle -> Open a cattle profile -> Delete the cattle record -> See the cattle removed from the herd

features.name: Daily Milking Records
features.description: Lets users review daily milking entries, filter them by date or cattle, add a milking session, and delete records.
user_flows: Navigate to /milking -> View today's milking records -> Filter records by date or cattle -> Review the filtered list
Navigate to /milking -> Open the add session flow -> Select cattle -> Choose the session period -> Enter yield in liters -> Submit the record -> See the new milking entry in the list
Navigate to /milking -> Open the add session flow -> Leave required fields incomplete -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback
Navigate to /milking -> Delete a milking record -> See the record removed from the list

features.name: Stock Management
features.description: Lets users manage feed and medicine inventory by adding stock items, recording usage, and reviewing low-stock warnings.
user_flows: Navigate to /stock -> View current stock items -> Review quantities and low-stock warnings
Navigate to /stock -> Open the add item flow -> Enter item name -> Choose a category -> Set a unit -> Enter quantity -> Submit the item -> See the new stock item in the inventory list
Navigate to /stock -> Open the record usage flow -> Select an existing stock item -> Enter usage quantity -> Enter usage date -> Submit the usage record -> See the stock quantity decrease
Navigate to /stock -> Open the add item flow -> Leave required stock fields incomplete -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback

features.name: App Settings
features.description: Provides access to profile information, notification preferences, and session logout.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> View user profile information -> Review notification preferences -> Change a preference
Navigate to /settings -> Sign out -> Return to the login screen

routes.description: User authentication screen with email/password login
Main dashboard showing farm KPIs and quick stats
Cattle list with search, filter, and management
Form to register a new cattle animal
Detailed profile and production history for a single cattle
Production stats for a specific cattle
Daily milking records - add, view, filter milking sessions
Feed and medicine stock management - add items and record usage
App settings including profile, notifications, and logout

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Login with email and password via Firebase Auth, with session persistence
user_interactions: Enter email address in the email input field
Enter password in the password input field
Tap the Login button to authenticate
See error message on invalid credentials
Auto-redirect to dashboard on successful login
Tap Logout in Settings to sign out

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Displays farm KPIs including total cattle count, daily milk production, revenue, and stock alerts
user_interactions: View total cattle count stat card
View today's milk production stat card
View low stock alerts
Navigate to cattle or milking screens via quick action buttons

features.name: Cattle Management
features.description: Full CRUD for cattle - list, add, view profile, and delete animals
user_interactions: View paginated list of all cattle
Search cattle by tag or name
Tap Add Cattle to open registration form
Fill in cattle details (tag number, breed, DOB, gender, weight)
Submit form to save new cattle
Tap a cattle card to view detailed profile
Delete a cattle record from profile screen

features.name: Daily Milking Records
features.description: Track daily milk yield per cattle session, with filtering by date and cattle
user_interactions: View list of milking records for today
Filter records by date or cattle
Tap Add Session to open the milking entry form
Select cattle, enter session (AM/PM), enter yield in liters
Submit milking record
Delete a milking record
View offline sync status indicator

features.name: Stock Management
features.description: Manage feed and medicine inventory - add stock items and record consumption/usage
user_interactions: View list of stock items with current quantities
Tap Add Item to register a new feed/medicine item
Fill in item name, category, unit, quantity
Submit new stock item
Tap Record Usage to deduct from an existing stock item
Enter usage quantity and date
View low-stock warnings

features.name: Offline-First Sync Engine
features.description: Transparent offline caching and sync queue for Cattle, Milking, and Stock modules via AsyncStorage
user_interactions: Perform any write operation while offline
See optimistic UI update immediately
Observe sync indicator when back online
Confirm data is persisted to Firestore after reconnection

features.name: App Settings
features.description: User profile, notification preferences, and session logout
user_interactions: View current user profile info
Toggle notification preferences
Tap Logout to sign out and return to login screen

known_limitations.issue: App is React Native / Expo mobile app with no web server endpoint; TestSprite browser tests target the Expo Web build
known_limitations.impact: Browser-based UI tests require running expo start --web on a local port

known_limitations.issue: Firebase calls require live Firebase project credentials in .env; tests use mocks
known_limitations.impact: Integration tests must mock Firebase SDK to avoid real network calls

known_limitations.issue: Offline sync queue tests depend on AsyncStorage mock
